integrity: The detailed proof supplies the unrestricted argument. A reproducible finite sieve checks examples only. The claim is not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: An unconditional necessity theorem for the actual remainder five, not an existence theorem. It does not eliminate even integers with at least three prime supports, nor odd integers with four or more prime supports.
title: A square-odd-part and prime-support obstruction for \(\sigma(n)\equiv5\pmod n\)
